states.name: Inhabited
states.description: Permanent population and routine commercial traffic.

states.name: Surveyed
states.description: Major bodies, hazards and resources characterized well enough for commercial expedition planning.

states.name: Partially Surveyed
states.description: System entered and some bodies examined; significant uncertainty remains.

states.name: Cataloged
states.description: Star and coarse system properties known remotely; no dependable local navigation or resource survey.

frontier_regions.name: Lastlight Outward Corridor
frontier_regions.description: The best documented path beyond permanent settlement. Survey craft have established several provisional navigation solutions, but there are no public rescue guarantees.

frontier_regions.name: Meridian Outer Arc
frontier_regions.description: A broad set of commercially interesting catalog targets not yet connected into a dependable route network.

design_rules: Survey information is tradeable economic information.
Not every surveyed system contains a profitable discovery.
A discovery becomes strategically important only when logistics can support exploiting or studying it.
Player activity can move locations from survey targets toward expedition camps and permanent settlements.
